summary: Tested the results draft/publish feature on the backend (new pytest, 17 tests: 13 pass, 4 fail) and on the frontend (/student-results as admin). Working: every import with commit=true is saved as a draft (draft:true, batch hidden:true, entries batch_hidden:true, notified 0). No notification is created at upload. /results/batches shows draft:true and notify_pending=1. The visibility endpoint on a draft returns 400. Publish makes entries visible, inserts exactly 1 'صدرت نتيجتك' notification, and sets draft:false with published_by_name. Publishing again returns 400. Publishing a manual, undone, event_only (pause/resume) batch or an invalid id returns 400/400/400/404. With notify=false, publish sends nothing. A manual edit on a draft entry keeps it hidden (draft_batch_id set) and publishing the draft reveals the edited values. Undoing a correction draft restores the previously published values. Undoing a new draft deletes the entry. Dean Salim with manage_results gets 403 publishing another faculty's batch and does not see it in his list. He can publish his own batch. With view_results only he gets 403. A /grades import commit gives a draft linked batch: L3S2 is hidden from /me/grades and /me/results until publish, then appears with 1 notification. Frontend: the wizard preview shows «حفظ كمسودة (1 صف)» and up-draft-note. The history card shows batch-draft badge «مسودة — غير منشورة», «سيُشعَر عند النشر 1» and batch-publish without a toggle. The confirm dialog names the 1 student. After publish the badge reads «منشورة», batch-toggle appears, and the success message is shown. Two backend logic bugs were found (below).

critical.issue: While a draft is pending, the student loses results that were already published. get_my_results picks the latest entry for (level, semester) by academic year, then returns None if that entry is hidden/batch_hidden, instead of falling back to the latest visible entry. Repro: student 1001 L1S1 2025-2026 shows ناجح/78. Import a draft for 2099-2100 L1S1 and the student now sees an empty first semester (status/gpa/grade all null) instead of the 2025-2026 result. get_my_grades has the same problem ('continue' skips the semester entirely instead of using an older visible record). Every upload is now a draft by default, so this blanks repeaters' old results until staff publish.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/results/batches/{id}/undo (draft batch after a manual edit)
critical.issue: An entry stays hidden forever. Repro: import draft D (L2S2), then POST /results/entries on the same student/key (entry gets batch_id=M, batch_hidden=True, draft_batch_id=D), then undo D. The change is skipped because cur.batch_id != D, so the entry keeps batch_hidden True and draft_batch_id=D, but D is undone and cannot be published (400). Later manual edits copy draft_batch_id=D again (upsert_entry uses before.draft_batch_id), so the result never becomes visible. The only way out is the batch visibility toggle on the manual batch. Fix: in _undo_batch (or upsert_entry), clear draft_batch_id/batch_hidden on entries whose draft_batch_id is the batch being undone, or ignore draft_batch_id that points to an undone batch.

minor.endpoint: POST /api/results/import (correction draft over a published same-year result)
minor.issue: Re-uploading a correction for an already-published (year, level, semester) overwrites the single entry document and hides it. The student sees an empty semester until the correction is published, rather than the old published values. This is a design limitation of in-place drafts; it could be handled together with the HIGH issue above.
data.notify overrides notify_on_publish, so an API caller can send notifications for a batch uploaded with notify=false. The UI sends {} so this is harmless; just noting it.

action_items: In get_my_results and get_my_grades, when the latest entry for (level, semester) is hidden or batch_hidden, fall back to the latest visible entry instead of returning empty or skipping.

Undoing a draft batch must release entries whose draft_batch_id == that batch (set batch_hidden False or recompute, and draft_batch_id None). upsert_entry should not inherit a draft_batch_id that points to an undone or published batch.
critical_code_review_comments: student_results.py is 799 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting the publish/undo/pause code into its own module.
Publish sends notifications with asyncio.create_task and no error logging, so a failure in insert_many is silently lost.

link_grades_import: when the user lacks manage_results (link_skipped), or the semester result is unchanged versus an existing published entry, the new grade sheet courses show to students immediately with no draft step. This conflicts with the requirement that results always start as a draft.

success_rate.backend: 76% (13/17; the 4 failures come from the 2 bugs above)

seed_data_creation: None. All test batches, entries, notifications and pause events in years 2099-2100/2097-2098 were undone or deleted by id. Student 1001's reg number was restored, Salim's permissions were restored, and results_pauses is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_results_draft_publish_iter209.py -v -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. The fixture restores everything. The failing tests are test_import_is_draft_hidden_no_notif, test_visibility_on_draft_400 and test_manual_edit_on_draft_stays_hidden (the last asserts in each check that the student still sees the 2025-2026 L1S1 base result while the draft is pending), plus test_draft_over_published_keeps_old_visible and test_undo_draft_after_manual_edit_not_stuck_hidden. For UI: set localStorage token/user from /api/auth/login, then goto /student-results. Pickers are native selects (up-sem, up-scope, up-target, up-level). The file input is up-file-input. The publish confirm is window.confirm. The upload year dropdown only offers 2026-2027/2025-2026, so create test drafts through the API with year 2099-2100.
rca of the issue: Bug 1: get_my_results.pick() uses _pick_latest() over all entries, then nulls the result if it is hidden. Hidden entries should be filtered out before picking the latest. Bug 2: _undo_batch only restores keys whose current batch_id equals the undone batch. Entries re-pointed to a manual batch keep draft_batch_id referring to the undone draft, and publish_batch rejects undone batches, so nothing ever clears batch_hidden.
